primaryWitnesses.text: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: 「エシュテモアの父」とする系譜上の人物用例で、町とは断定できない。

primaryWitnesses.text: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.
primaryWitnesses.decisionJa: 「エシュテモア人」とする系譜・出自表現で、町そのものの記述ではない。

primaryWitnesses.text: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
primaryWitnesses.previousContext: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
primaryWitnesses.nextContext: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,
